manuscript.title: A sharp forest bound and an improved whisker bound for finite WARM graphs

claim_scope.model: Fixed finite simple undirected loopless graph; independent positive Poisson vertex rates; fixed positive integer edge counts; power reinforcement alpha>1; isolated vertices harmless.
claim_scope.forest: For each alpha>4/3 and arbitrary positive rates, E_infinity is a forest almost surely.
claim_scope.whisker: For equal rates and alpha>=17/4, every E_infinity component has diameter<=3 almost surely.
claim_scope.sharpness: Each1<alpha<4/3 equal-rate unit-start triangle retains all3edges with positive probability; no smaller universal forest cutoff.
claim_scope.initialization: Finite-prefix conditioning transfers almost-sure tail conclusions from unit counts to positive integer counts; no reverse attainment transfer claimed.
claim_scope.stochastic_bridge: Published HHK2023 Theorem1 plus Proposition1, directly checked at exact finite model and support/boundary hypotheses.
exclusions: Infinite graphs, loops, zero counts, arbitrary noninteger offsets
Novelty/firstness, external human peer review, proof-assistant certification

incidental_exposure: Manuscript final disclosure describes old audits and status labels.

Necessary current helper dependencies contain historical custody and bounded-priority status assertions; replay mechanically parses these. No such assertion was adopted as mathematical or priority evidence.

independent_evidence.instability_witnesses: Stored rational vectors with exact positive Hessian energies; trigonometric approximations only selected candidates.
independent_evidence.unbounded_tail: Analytic quadratic identity and exact Taylor/geometric-tail bound checked.
independent_evidence.scope_countercontrol: Exactly strictly stable unequal-rate4-edge path atalpha5; positive leading principal minors of negative Hessian. Not a counterexample to equal-rate claim.
